content: Dapiyarini, Shiy Apaa, opeejpan ksutamapan ashirush nuwaa uru ksutaksha

content.text: Shiy Apaa, opeejpan tputs tamapari ashirush, nuwaa wanasir ksutaksha.
Opeejpan chinoo wanasir ksutku, pastush maritachu, kungootstam waamaam wayakchu,
Shiyshat Apaa, ashikpaz ashiritam nuwaa wanasir ksutkush,
nuwsha Apaa, shiyamun mangi kis kanuskina.
Wizpuriri ndunareekchu, shiysha Apaa, nuwaa arang tuwizpurtaksha.
Ashkachuri, nuwamun tputssha shiyaa wanasir napchinllinaya.
nuw tsipatsee punikeezi, watam shiysha Apaa, nuwaa nda kasakshawa.
Chinuzpan tamapari ashirush yungashpatish, mishat tushuwashpatish nuwaa ksuteerush machiksha.
Ashiri nuwsha shiyapat mapiyru kis naakina.
Kundarari nuwaa natsaktaatssin, nuwaa napanapaw ashkitaatssin, itaru shiysha Apaa, nuwaa chinakush, katungsheemtamti nuwaam panaksha.
Shiysha Apaa, nuwaa kizpur kasiru ksutaksha.
shiy kizpur nuwaa chinakush, nayanikush, taarasheetsi ichingaru zar ksutaksha.
Ashiri tsipakchuri, shiyash urutamari kis taachima,

footnotes.text: -2 Wanga 10.14-16; Utaáshucheema 13.20; 1 Pitoru 5.4 tsiyatsis nipta tatsamooru taaritamta.
-2 Apanll wanichu anu 7.17 tsiyatsis nipta tatsamooru taaritamta.
